title: David Walliams’ London home on sale for £10.5 million amid sexual misconduct involving teenage fans
summary_full: David Walliams’ luxurious four-bedroom townhouse in London’s prestigious Regent’s Park area has been listed for £10.5 million, as the comedian faces renewed scrutiny following allegations of inappropriate sexual behaviour towards teenage girls and women. The former Britain’s Got Talent judge reportedly bought the property for £8.45 million in 2013. The development comes after a High Court battle over attempts to prevent the publication of allegations against him, which he denies.
